meta_schemas.name: Meta Relation Schema
meta_schemas.meaning: Generic admissible relation schema for legal typed binary relation operators.
meta_schemas.reading: A stands in some legal typed relation to B along an admissible continuation path x.
meta_schemas.reserved_path_variable_note: Reserved for generic discussion only within this meta-schema; not a proof operator suffix.
restrictions: May not appear in proofs, derivations, or theorem statements.
Does not itself confer truth conditions.
operand_constraints: A and B must be typed operands with declared admissibility context.
Bare physical objects, undefined metaphors, and untyped scalar outputs are forbidden operands.
Projection signatures are legal only when explicitly marked with _app or another declared projection suffix.

operators.name: Admissibility Predicate
operators.domain: Candidate state x', context c, residue R, orientation -(i)
operators.closure_condition: AND conjunction of Gamma_E, Gamma_R, Gamma_T, Gamma_O
composition_rules: Basis for delta_a set-builder
Non-transitive due to residue evolution
Separates kernel shell from mechanism constraints

operators.name: Topological Organization Object
operators.codomain: Constraint structure (Lambda, N, B, O, K, R)
operators.closure_condition: Maintains connectivity and closure class invariants
composition_rules: Updated by residue relation operand (R_↔ -> T)
Input to admissibility (T -> A_adm)

operators.name: Admissibility-Constrained Continuation
operators.domain: Nonzero distinguishability (E != 0) OR comparison block B
operators.codomain: Admissible continuation candidate set {Q_alpha} OR admissible block A
operators.closure_condition: Selection of a single future state within admissibility window A, OR filtering of a block to its lawful subset.
composition_rules: L082 Precedence
L083 Idempotence
Consumes the S-stage pruned candidate set before final arbitration
Filters a comparison block, yielding only the subset accepted as a lawful comparison object

operators.name: Typed Relational Comparison Operator
operators.closure_condition: A lawful RT candidate forms when two admissible blocks enter typed whole-expression comparison without identity collapse.

operators.name: Orientation Calculus
operators.domain: Typed orientation conditions over RT and aRT operands
operators.codomain: Admissible orientation actions, equivalence classes, identity action, and partial compositions
operators.closure_condition: Orientation transformation remains lawful only while typed distinction, admissibility, and closure class are preserved
operators.collapse_mode: Orientation degeneracy / admissibility empty-set / typed closure failure
composition_rules: Includes typed action O_x over RT and aRT operands
Includes partial composition only when output orientation class is an admissible input for the next action
Includes identity action id_O preserving typed operand and closure class
failure_conditions: FAIL_O_001: orientation degeneracy prevents selection of a determinate admissible class
FAIL_O_002: distinction collapses below operative floor epsilon
FAIL_O_003: closure support fails for the typed operand
FAIL_O_005: admissible continuation set becomes empty
FAIL_O_006: composition attempts to chain incompatible orientation classes

operators.name: Orientation Action Operator
operators.domain: Orientation condition o in O, typed operand X in {RT, aRT}
operators.closure_condition: Lawful only if distinction, admissibility, and closure class are preserved under context x
operators.collapse_mode: Typed operand violation / closure-support loss / distinction collapse

operators.name: Orientation-Array Transport
operators.domain: Orientation condition o_k, residue relation R_<->, admissibility structure A_adm, transition organization T
operators.closure_condition: Reconciliation is lawful only when the next orientation condition remains admissible for the typed operand and preserves closure class
operators.collapse_mode: Transport decoherence / array fragmentation / admissible next-orientation failure
composition_rules: Transitivity across admissibility chains
Maps among admissible orientation conditions in O rather than through primitive space

operators.name: Admissibility-Governed Arbitration
operators.closure_condition: Optimal mismatch minimization (O*) under constraint A
composition_rules: Precedes interaction and projection
Escalates to orientation-selection when current admissible continuation cannot preserve closure support under the existing orientation pattern
Consumes the S-stage pruned candidate set before realization

candidate_rules.Trigger_Reorient: Invoked when the current admissible candidate set is empty, closure support drops below its admissible threshold, or admissible deformation requires a new orientation reference.

operators.name: Residue Relation Operand
operators.domain: Residue conditions produced by lawful continuation
operators.closure_condition: Trace-relation remains legible enough to condition topology without becoming a direct update operator
composition_rules: Inscribed by lawful continuation (Delta -> R_↔)
Conditions topology (R_↔ -> T)
Not itself the closure operator
Not a direct causal updater

operators.name: Recursive Knot Stabilization (Identity)
operators.closure_condition: Fixed-point convergence under update operator Psi where loop > Theta_D
composition_rules: Requires N=3 independent closure constraints

operators.name: Forward Admissibility Projection
operators.closure_condition: Existence of admissible correspondence from A to B

operators.name: Reverse Admissibility Projection
operators.closure_condition: Existence of admissible correspondence from B to A

operators.name: Forward Residue Continuation
operators.closure_condition: Residue in A supports continuation toward B

operators.name: Reverse Residue Support
operators.closure_condition: B provides residue support relative to A

operators.name: Admissibility-Residue Coupling Operator
operators.closure_condition: Joint support from forward admissibility and reverse residue

operators.name: Typed Partial Composition Operator
operators.domain: Typed operands X and Z under declared composition context Y
operators.codomain: A lawful RT, aRT, or typed_closure_candidate result
operators.closure_condition: Composition is lawful only when operand typing, distinction preservation, admissibility, and closure-class compatibility all remain satisfied under Y
operators.collapse_mode: Typing failure / admissibility empty-set / closure incompatibility / ordering collapse / projection equivalence drift
composition_rules: X otimes_Y Z is defined only when Type(X), Type(Z), and Context(Y) are declared
D(X|Z) must remain above epsilon unless a collapse-boundary event is explicitly declared
delta_a(X otimes_Y Z) must remain non-empty
Result must remain in RT union aRT union typed_closure_candidate
Associativity may hold only inside a declared compatible closure class
failure_conditions: FAIL_OTIMES_001: missing or invalid operand typing
FAIL_OTIMES_007: projection equivalence mistaken for process identity
FAIL_OTIMES_008: unproven commutativity or associativity assumed

operators.name: Asymmetry Ratio
operators.closure_condition: D12/D21 regulated by distinguishability floor epsilon

operators.name: Asymmetry Bridge Operator
operators.closure_condition: Generative induction of orientation from asymmetry ratio

operators.name: Cross-Basin Projection (Bridge)
operators.closure_condition: Update density crosses scale threshold tau and satisfies homogenization (L094)
operators.collapse_mode: Projection failure (update density < tau or variance too high)
composition_rules: Gated by stabilization operator K
Subject to non-invertibility and information loss (L093)
Requires relational convolution kernel K (L092)

operators.name: Residue-Conditioned Closure
operators.domain: Typed operands A, B under admissibility support
operators.closure_condition: A ↔_R B is true only while admissible residue-conditioned topology preserves closure support between the operands
operators.collapse_mode: Decoupling (truth transition True -> False) when distinction, admissibility support, trace relation, operand typing, or closure topology fails
composition_rules: Not the residue state itself
Not a proof operator
Depends on admissibility support generated through Delta -> R_↔ -> T -> A_adm
Operates over typed operands such as RT expressions, aRT expressions, distinction-nodes, triadic closure candidates, admissible topology signatures, and explicitly marked projection signatures

operators.name: Orientation Braid Operator
operators.closure_condition: Fixed-point closure (B_K^m Psi = Psi) for integer/half-integer m
composition_rules: Composition of n orientation updates around knot K

operators.name: Projection Operators (Pi_A, Pi_R)
operators.closure_condition: Mapping to invariant relational signatures
composition_rules: Terminal derivation stage

operators.name: Metric Projection Operator
operators.closure_condition: Successful mapping of relational structure to scalar metrics

operators.name: Statistical Projection Operator
operators.domain: Typed process structures X in {RT, aRT, typed_composition_structure, metric_projection, asymmetry_ratio, admissibility_distribution_candidate}
operators.codomain: Statistical observables P_X explicitly marked as statistical_projection_app
operators.closure_condition: Projection is lawful only when operand typing, declared projection map, non-empty admissibility support, and normalization status all remain explicit
operators.collapse_mode: Typing failure / undeclared projection map / admissibility empty-set / undeclared normalization / projection identity drift
composition_rules: X iff_s P_X is defined only when Type(X) and ProjectionMap_s(X) are declared
A_adm(X) must remain non-empty
P_X must be marked as statistical_projection_app
Norm(P_X) must be declared as normalized, conditionally_normalized, or comparative_weight
P_X = P_Y does not imply X = Y
failure_conditions: FAIL_IFF_S_001: missing or invalid operand typing
FAIL_IFF_S_005: projection equivalence mistaken for process identity
FAIL_IFF_S_006: raw simulation frequency treated as governed probability
FAIL_IFF_S_007: probability assigned outside declared admissibility window

operators.name: Preserved Distinction
operators.domain: Two distinguishable process relata A, B with active distinction D(A|B) > 0
operators.codomain: A baseline relation claim asserting procedural participation without identity collapse
operators.closure_condition: Relation and distinction co-survive without collapsing A and B into the same operational role
operators.collapse_mode: Identity collapse / relation without distinction / untested conditioning drift
composition_rules: Acts as the bare preserved-distinction baseline
Subscripts are candidate conditioning qualifiers and must outperform the bare baseline before retention
Does not replace residue-conditioned closure ↔_R
Remains provisional until truth conditions and counterexamples are formally settled

operators.name: Preserved Non-Identity Relation
operators.domain: Typed operands A, B under declared context X
operators.codomain: Relation claim preserving typed non-identity under context X
truth_conditions: D(A|B) > epsilon or typed nonzero distinction is preserved
A and B remain coupled under context X
A and B do not collapse into the same operational role
composition_rules: Does not replace ↔_R
Adds a non-collapse constraint to an already typed relation context
Remains provisional until directional and counterexample behavior is formally settled

operators.name: vertical_bar_operator
operators.domain: Admissible distinction-participation separator inside grouped expressions
operators.codomain: Interface for co-participation in distinction-generating expressions
operators.closure_condition: A | B marks the oriented comparison interface through which A and B participate in a distinction-generating expression.
composition_rules: Used within TC_asym to mark co-participation in grouped expressions
Must be defined before Org_a closure is attempted
operators.reversal_rule: Reversal is legal only if Rev_|(A,B) or higher grouped orientation equivalence is proven.
operators.group_preservation_rule: Preserve_O(G -> G') := ∃o ∈ O(G), ∃o' ∈ O(G') such that G iff_R G' while preserving admissible orientation.

operators.name: Admissible Organization Operator
operators.domain: Typed grouped participation graph G satisfying Adm_|^G(G) and O(G)
operators.codomain: Legally preserved organization of admissible distinction participation

requires: exists o in O(G) such that Adm_O(G,o)

axioms.name: Inventory Preservation
axioms.statement: Legal transformations under Org_a must preserve the admissible distinction inventory of G.
axioms.candidate_form: Inv_D(G) = Inv_D(G') under G iff_R G'
axioms.meaning: The organization may deform, regroup, or transform only if the participating distinction inventory remains traceable.

axioms.name: Admissibility Conservation
axioms.statement: Every legal transformation under Org_a must preserve admissibility of the organized participation field.
axioms.candidate_form: Org_a(G) and G iff_R G' implies Adm_a(G')
axioms.meaning: No organization remains legal if transformation causes its distinction participation to fall below epsilon_a or violate typed participation.

axioms.name: Topological Consistency
axioms.statement: Legal transformations under Org_a must preserve orientation-consistent participation structure.
axioms.candidate_form: Org_a(G) and G iff_R G' implies G ≃_O G'
axioms.meaning: The organization is preserved through admissible relational structure, not by visual shape or object identity.

derived_closure_candidate.candidate_formula: Adm_Org(G) := Adm_|^G(G) ∧ ∃o∈O(G) Adm_O(G,o) ∧ Eval_D^G(G) ∧ D_G(G)>epsilon_a ∧ InvPres_D(G) ∧ AdmCons_a(G) ∧ TopCons_O(G)
derived_closure_candidate.interpretation: An Org_a expression is admissibly closed only when grouped participation, orientation, distinction evaluation, inventory preservation, admissibility conservation, and topological consistency all hold.
